2608.21023.title: Scaling Unsupervised Word Alignment to Documents via Structural Constraints
2608.21023.paper_summary: Word alignment has traditionally been studied between sentences, but many cross-lingual tasks increasingly require correspondences across full documents. While recent multilingual embedding models can encode long inputs, we show that applying algorithms designed for sentences directly to documents leads to performance degradation. To address this, we introduce CTFAlign, a lightweight, training-free approach for document-level word alignment. CTFAlign applies a coarse-to-fine refinement strategy that restricts the alignment search space to semantically similar regions. Additionally, we introduce MDPAlign, a simpler alternative that constrains alignments by position with a main diagonal prior. Both approaches operate directly on full documents without relying on sentence segmentation or sentence alignment. We evaluate these methods across six language pairs varying in typological distance, resourcedness, and document length. Averaged over three models, CTFAlign reduces word alignment error rate from 0.412 to 0.326. These gains transfer downstream, leading to improvements in document-level translation coverage evaluation and recognition of semantic differences. We release CTFAlign as a Python package and make the code and data to reproduce our experiments publicly available.
2608.21023.paper_summary_zh: 詞彙對齊傳統上是在句子之間進行研究，但許多跨語言任務越來越需要在整個文檔中尋找對應關係。雖然最近的多語言嵌入模型可以編碼長輸入，但我們顯示將為句子設計的算法直接應用於文檔會導致性能下降。為了解決這個問題，我們介紹了CTFAlign，一種輕量級、無需訓練的文檔級詞彙對齊方法。CTFAlign採用粗到細的精煉策略，將對齊搜索空間限制在語義相似的區域。此外，我們還介紹了MDPAlign，一種更簡單的替代方案，通過主對角線先驗來限制對齊的位置。這兩種方法直接在完整文檔上運作，而不依賴於句子分段或句子對齊。我們在六對語言上評估這些方法，這些語言在類型距離、資源豐富程度和文檔長度上有所不同。在三個模型的平均下，CTFAlign將詞彙對齊錯誤率從0.412降低到0.326。這些增益向下傳遞，導致文檔級翻譯覆蓋評估和語義差異識別的改進。我們將CTFAlign作為Python包發布，並公開提供重現我們實驗的代碼和數據。
